column2: It was kinda hurt, so I picked it up and fed it. But it doesn't look like a bad injury.
Thank you for helping her.
Oh my, did you find the owner?
Yeah, she says this owl is hers.
Well, isn't that nice.
What's your name, dear?
I-Irene...
Do you live around here? I don't recognize you.
I'm traveling, and Vesta here went missing on the way...
My, traveling alone at your age? That must be hard. I'm sure you have your reasons.
I know, come over to our place. There's food, too. How about it?
Oh, no, that's all right, really...
Nonsense, we all need help sometimes. Don't be shy, now!
Blind Mage
Imperial Warrior
Grand Master!
...A child?
Did you do this?
And if I did, what of it, young lady?
That's horrible... I won't forgive you!
Hehehe. A few filthy mages vanishing from this world is hardly anything to fly into a rage over.
Get away from him!
Such fire. Does this doddering old mage's life matter so much to you?
You monster... If you don't stop this, I really won't forgive you...!!
Hmph... there's no point swinging this sword of mine at a child.
Should you ever appear before me again, I will take you on then, young lady.
I leave the rest to you.
Warrior
Sir!
Master!
Who is it?
I'm Zig's granddaughter... My name is Irene.
Oh, I see...
Irene... listen. Fein, too... and this lodge, have fallen to the Empire...
No... Fein?
Yes...
The Empire, with Serenis working in its shadows, took the Demon Stone from here... She is already in the grip of evil...
Irene...
Please restore the pride of the mages that Zig, Fein and the Guild protected... I beg you...
...I grow bored.
My sword has drunk too much blood already... Enough playing with a little girl.
Another time, I'll make you my sword's prey, little witch.
Guild Master
But this lodge, too, has finally fallen to the Empire... The Empire took the Demon Stone from here...
The Demon Stone...?!
Irene... I must ask this of you, the child Zig left behind...
Protect the future of the Guild and its mages... I beg you...
It's Irene.
Oh... Irene...
Are you all right...?
Yes... it seems he forgot to finish me off...
But the Demon Stone has been taken.
The Demon Stone? The one from Delphinia?
Yes... that is what the stone is said to be.
There was an ill-omened prophecy, so we guarded the stone here...
Master, it's dangerous here. The imperial soldiers may come back.
Let's leave the town.
Yes... very well.
Grand Master, why on earth is the Empire doing all this...?
A legend from a thousand years ago... They plan to revive the Crimson Moon King.
It can't be...
No... Serenis, in the grip of evil, means to carry it out...
My sister...?!
Yes, the Guild has confirmed it. Serenis is at the imperial court...
No...
Surely you do not still think of Serenis as your sister...
Revived by a forbidden secret art, she is no longer your sister...
I... I can't give up. Serenis is... my sister...
Can't give up...
Fein said the same... But... the outcome will not change... Accept it, Irene.
I'm sorry, Grand Master.
No matter how many times I'm told, until I see my sister... no, until I bring her back... I won't give up...
...I see. Zig's blood... once you decide something, you won't listen...
I am heading to the lodge in Legrance. Come and visit me anytime.
Irene, you are still young... never throw your life away...
Yes... Grand Master.
Serenis has crossed into the Empire and is at its court... The Guild has confirmed it...
To think that tragedy would lead to this...
...I'll stop my sister.
You can't, Irene. That secret art... turns a person's body into an empty shell.
That is why it has been forbidden since ancient times.
She is no longer your sister, nor Fein's wife.
I... I can't give up. Serenis is my sister...
